messages:
Maya (PM): Ok team — need final plan for rolling out the latency-envelope canary with an autoshed token quota. Goal: staged regions, per-tenant opt-in, and automatic fallback if tail latency or errors spike.
Ravi (Eng): Proposed rollout flow: shadow 1% globally -> 5% regional canary (gradual) -> 25% region if all checks pass. Warmup tokens + soft-traffic ramp.
Jon (SRE): Ops constraints: p95 threshold = 350ms; if p95 > 350ms for 5m or error-rate > 1% for 5m -> autoshed or reroute. Hard kill if >5% errors sustained 5m.
Evelyn (Data): Telemetry plan: tag = rollout.experiment:latency-envelope, include dataset id env-canary-2026. Map control/variant to telemetry keys for A/B analysis.
Maya (PM): Quick checklist for launch criteria? We should lock pass/fail gates. ✅
Ravi (Eng): Live checks: p50/p95/p99 latency, token-cost delta, top-5 error codes, throughput. Thresholds: p95 <= 350ms, cost delta <= 8%, evaluation regression <= 0.5% on our prompt set.
Jon (SRE): Recovery/runbook snippet (short):
```
# Ops runbook (abridged)
/rollout/fallback -> set-flag ff.model.routing=v2-quantized
/rollout/evict -> set-flag ff.latency-envelope.*=off
/ops/restore -> route to dedicated pool + notify oncall
```
Maya (PM): Naming convention: `ff.latency-envelope.<region>.<variant>.auto-shed`. Keep it explicit so ops can filter.
Evelyn (Data): A/B hypothesis: "variant reduces tail latency >=10% w/o cost >8%". Owners: @Evelyn, @Ravi. Add experiment_id to every event.
Ravi (Eng): Autoshed algorithm (sketch): token_quota window=1m. If tenant_qps > quota -> shed proportionally by tenant priority; low-priority tenants fall back to cached responses or reduced model. Also expose `autoshed_rate` in telemetry.
Jon (SRE): Observability hooks required: per-tenant latency heatmap, canary delta alert, autoshed counter metric. Alert targets: #eng-oncall + PagerDuty. Add a daily digest during rollout.
Maya (PM): Customer gating: console + API opt-in flag `rollout_optin=true`. Sales asked for email notif on opt-in events -> OpsBot can emit.
Ravi (Eng): Soft-launch config prototype:
```json
{
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "warmup_tokens": 5000,
  "monitoring_keys": ["latency_p95","token_cost_delta"]
}
```
(we'll store that in the flag config)
Evelyn (Data): Stats: use rolling-window bootstrap for significance, min sample size 1k reqs per bucket before calling results. Keep effect size tracking and incremental checks.
Jon (SRE): Timeline proposal: canary deploy Fri 21:00 UTC, monitor 3h, decision checkpoint at +4h. Kill-switch available to org owners.
Maya (PM): Operational notes: add a manual override for per-tenant opt-out, and a cooldown window after a rollback to avoid flip-flopping.
Ravi (Eng): I'll open a PR with: flag names, runbook links, telemetry mapping, and the experiment config by EOD.
Maya (PM): Great — please @channel when PR is up. Final ask: add a short blurb for customer success so they can prep comms for opt-in customers. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): On it. Will ping when PR is up and put runbook into /ops/runbooks/latency-envelope-canary.
thread_summary: Short planning thread to finalize a regional canary rollout that enforces latency envelopes with an autoshed token quota, including launch criteria, observability, runbook snippets, per-tenant opt-in, and timeline.
